LanguageData.LP_RedWizardCamp.label: Red Wizard camp
LanguageData.LP_RedWizardCamp.description: Thayan Red Wizards are camped here, with one elite wizard in the camp.
LanguageData.LP_RedWizardCamp.arrivedLetter: This is a Red Wizard camp. Killing the elite Red Wizard completes Larloch's second errand.
LanguageData.LP_LarlochCrypt.label: Larloch's tomb
LanguageData.LP_LarlochCrypt.description: The tomb of Larloch the Shadow King: stone burial chambers guarded by skeletons, flesh golems, demiliches and an avatar of Larloch. The Scroll of Karsus lies in the central hall.
LanguageData.LP_LarlochCrypt.arrivedLetter: This is Larloch's tomb. The Scroll of Karsus is on the shelf in the central hall.
LanguageData.LP_NetherilWreck.label: wreck of a sunken Netherese flying city
LanguageData.LP_NetherilWreck.description: A wreck of a Netherese flying city has risen from underground, and the Scroll of Karsus fell inside. Someone got here first.
LanguageData.LP_NetherilWreck.arrivedLetter: This is the wreck of a sunken Netherese flying city; the Scroll of Karsus is in the middle of the wreck.
